description:
Personality Social Network Enclavd: Personality social network.
Stop broadcasting into the void. Enclavd is a social network built on compatibility. Take a personality quiz, get matched with people on your wavelength, and connect through a feed built around who you actually are.
CORE PRINCIPLES Personality Types: Your feed is filtered by personality. Find people who are on the same frequency. Quality Content: We maintain high quality standards for content, removing spam and curating the feed. Clean Interface: A clean, stripped-back design built for focus, with nothing competing for your attention.
WHO ENCLAVD IS FOR
- You're tired of social media feeds. - You're looking for real conversations. - You'd rather join through a trusted network than scroll past bots.
Enclavd is a social network for people who want depth over reach.
Take the quiz. Find your matches. Build your enclave.
Download Enclavd and stop existing for the feed.
